selection_rule: Longest complete-paragraph prefix of the finalized abstract whose plain text is at most 2000 Unicode characters. No detector-driven selection. Resolve LaTeX macros from recorded report values, preserve wording and paragraph order. If fewer than 80 words fit, stop and document scope constraint.
scope: Same exact fixed excerpt on all eligible services, not whole report.
prohibited_actions: interpreting stale background scores as current
evidence: input and source SHA256 before submission
comparability: No aggregate whole-report score; changed text/length/model means prior revisions are not a controlled authorship experiment.
